title: An export_dataset call with a filter the dataset does not take is corrected and retried in the same run
note: The alerts dataset takes only filters.timeRange (rejectUnknownFilters in services/aiToolsExportDatasets/alerts.ts), so a status filter answers invalid_filter. The prompt asks for 'active' alerts to make the run try one. It is a rate, not a constant: if the run never passes a status filter the precondition fails and the run is inconclusive (UNEXPECTED FAIL), not a pass. The tool row status of a refused filter is not asserted (the handler returns the error as a normal result); the failure is read from ai_tool_executions.tool_output instead.

steps.name: launch
steps.text: Start an analysis across the whole Northwind Dental organization. Export the alerts dataset filtered with status set to active, then count the alerts by severity.

steps.name: settled
steps.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_agent_runs where profile = 'analysis' and queued_at > {{since}} and status in ('completed','failed','cancelled')

steps.name: report
steps.text: What did the analysis find about the alerts?

checks.sql: select (count(*) > 0)::text from ai_tool_executions where tool_name = 'export_dataset' and created_at > {{since}} and tool_input::text like '%alerts%' and tool_output::text like '%invalid_filter%'
checks.note: the run really sent an unsupported filter and was refused

checks.sql: select (exists (select 1 from ai_tool_executions f where f.tool_name = 'export_dataset' and f.created_at > {{since}} and f.tool_output::text like '%invalid_filter%' and exists (select 1 from ai_tool_executions s where s.session_id = f.session_id and s.tool_name = 'export_dataset' and s.created_at > f.created_at and s.tool_input::text like '%alerts%' and s.tool_output::text not like '%invalid_filter%' and s.tool_output::text not like '%invalid_time_range%' and s.tool_output::text not like '%export_failed%')))::text
checks.note: a refused export is followed, in the same run session, by an alerts export that was not refused
